facts.fact: During April 2024 to March 2025, 95,520 Social Cash Transfer Programme and 195,520 public works beneficiaries in 10 World Bank-funded districts were enrolled on e-payments and received MWK 4.57 billion and MWK 21.08 billion in e-wallets, per the World Bank aide memoire citing NLGFC.

systems.platform: e-wallets via TNM, Airtel, FDH, Standard Bank, Wealthnet Finance (Kaku Pay), NBS Bank
